ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the the B1-2,
Neighborhood Shopping Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 7-J in the area
bound by:

      the alley next north of and parallel to West Wrightwood Avenue; North Central Park
      Avenue; West Wrightwood Avenue; a line 78.52 feet east of and parallel to North
      Lawndale Avenue; a line 70.27 feet north of and parallel to West Wrightwood Avenue;
      and North Lawndale Avenue,

to those of a B3-1, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                        ____________________________
                                                        Carlos Ramirez-Rosa
                                                        Alderman, 35th Ward




Common Address:
3600-50 West Wrightwood Avenue
2609-11 North Lawndale Avenue
